Add telemetry instrumentation for EF Core in our C# app

evals.prompt: Configure OpenTelemetry tracing in this ASP.NET Core service so traces export to the local OTLP endpoint described in OPERATIONS.md, with incoming HTTP requests instrumented.
evals.expected_output: OTLP exporter is configured with an endpoint and trace settings.
expectations: The OpenTelemetry packages (hosting extensions, ASP.NET Core instrumentation, OTLP exporter) are added to OrdersApi.csproj
Tracing is enabled via AddOpenTelemetry().WithTracing() with ASP.NET Core instrumentation
The resource is configured with service name orders-api and version 1.4.0
The OTLP exporter targets http://localhost:4317, preferably from configuration rather than a hard-coded literal
